narr: A healthy upper level trough and frontal boundary moved from Ontario into VT during the overnight hours of July 20th. Ahead of this system, a vigorous squall line of thunderstorms that developed in Ontario during the early afternoon hours moved across northern NY from mid-afternoon into the evening hours and evening hours across VT with numerous reports of damaging winds.
ev: Butternut Hill Road washed out gravel road due to heavy rainfall.
